_comment: Reusable exclude_patterns for SSL pretraining configs. Each pattern is an underscore-anchored substring that catches exactly one treatment tag and nothing else (verified against data/patches_128_from_zip). PatchDataset matches case-insensitively, so the casing here does not matter.

_notes._PP_: Catches the 20 PP runs only (NOT PPNC2 or PPKONTROLA — those contain PP but are anchored differently).
_notes._NC_: Catches the 7 NC runs only (NOT NCH or PPNC2).
_notes._PSI1H01UM_: User wrote 'PSI1H01UM'; real files use lowercase 'PSI1h01uM' but matching is case-insensitive, so the uppercase form is fine.
_notes._KONTROLAHARMIN_: User wrote 'KONTROLLAHARMIN' (double L). Real tag is 'KONTROLAHARMIN' (single L); using the real spelling here.
_notes._NCH_: User wrote 'NHC'. Closest existing tag is 'NCH' (1 run). If 'NHC' was intentional and refers to something else, no matching files exist.
_notes._ORGANOID: Trailing underscore omitted because 'ORGANOID' appears as a prefix (e.g. ORGANOID_KONTROLA_0HOD_…). Catches 2 runs.
